request.prompt: Edit this narrow hanging faction pennant for an elegant premium Kalistar fantasy card. First reference is the existing pennant: retain its narrow pointed silhouette, fine aged copper hem, small side tails, woven cloth and natural folds, flat frontal view. Completely remove the enormous numeral and exclamation mark. Replace the burgundy field with luminous white woven silk, light natural grey fold shadows. Use the second reference as Snake portrait guidance: paint his recognizable bandana face in refined charcoal and restrained deep red brushwork, mostly monochrome, as an embroidered/ink-painted emblem in the middle of the white fabric. Beautiful restrained editorial composition, portrait recognizable at 100 pixels wide. Put the authentic condensed METAL GEAR SOLID wordmark near the upper part, small charcoal lettering with a subtle red accent; no standalone number 1, no additional text, no lettering at the tip. Portrait is the focal point, text secondary. Keep the copper hem thin, no extra ornaments. Produce only this one isolated complete tall pennant, centered with narrow transparent margin, no scene, no card, no UI. Same height-to-width proportion as target. Painterly physical cloth, not a glossy 3D badge or modern poster.
